description_en: Queries the list of unassigned servers in a hybrid cloud cluster
description_zh: 查询混合云集群未分配服务器列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-unassigned-machines --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-5yd00007009 --cluster-id 123 --ip 1.X.X.1 --host-name online-xagent1 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudUnassignedMachines

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the server that you want to query
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the server that you want to query
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland

WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
